documents.title: Atlas (프로젝트 아틀라스) 2026 Operations Spec
documents.text: Atlas (프로젝트 아틀라스) runs on SQLite WAL inside Rust Core. As of 2026-01-15, the project owner is Lee Jiwon and service port is 4825.

documents.title: Atlas 2024 Legacy Spec
documents.text: In 2024, Atlas was owned by Kim Minsoo and listened on legacy port 94825.

documents.title: Atlas Architecture & Dependencies
documents.text: Rust Core depends on SQLite WAL for Atlas. Lee Jiwon reviews all schema migrations for 프로젝트 아틀라스.

documents.title: Atlas Unverified Draft Note
documents.text: Draft note claims Atlas uses port 84825 instead of 4825 (unverified conflict with operations spec).

documents.title: Atlas Restricted Org Budget
documents.text: Restricted workspace ws-eval-restricted: Atlas confidential budget is 990M KRW.
